# `kontent mapi <endpoint>`

<!-- The section between the reference markers is generated by `pnpm docs:generate` from the yargs definitions; edit those, not the section. Prose outside the markers is handwritten and yours to edit. -->

<!-- reference:start -->
Send an authenticated request to the Management API

## Usage

```sh
kontent mapi <endpoint> [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<endpoint>` | string | API path, e.g. "types" or "projects/{environment_id}/types" |

## Options

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--envId` | string | **Required.** Environment ID (Guid) |
| `--mapiKey` | string | Management API key. Defaults to the logged-in user's token |
| `--method`, `-X` | string | HTTP method. (default: GET, or POST with --input) |
| `--header`, `-H` | string[] | Request header in the "Name: value" format. Repeatable. An Authorization header takes precedence over --mapiKey and the stored login token |
| `--input` | string | File with the request body, or "-" to read stdin |
| `--include`, `-i` | boolean | Print the status line and response headers before the body |

## Examples

```sh
# List the first 10 content types
kontent mapi 'types?limit=10' --envId <id>

# Create a content type from a file (--input implies POST)
kontent mapi types --envId <id> --input body.json

# Delete a content item
kontent mapi 'items/<item-id>' -X DELETE --envId <id>

# Send extra headers (-H is repeatable)
kontent mapi types -H 'X-Foo: 1' -H 'X-Bar: 2' --envId <id>

# Create a content type from a piped body
echo '{"name":"Article"}' | kontent mapi types --envId <id> --input -
```
<!-- reference:end -->
